mapper.sql: emp41_eval_list_id AS eval_list_id, emp41_eval_list_std_id AS eval_list_std_id, emp41_eval_class_cd AS eval_class_code, f_cdnm('EmpEvalClassCode', emp41_eval_class_cd, emp40_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS eval_class_name, emp41_content AS content, emp41_weight_member AS weight_member, emp41_weight_leader AS weight_leader, emp41_seq AS seq
mapper.select: SELECT FROM emp41_eval_list INNER JOIN emp40_eval_list_std ON emp41_eval_list_std_id = emp40_eval_list_std_id WHERE emp41_eval_list_std_id = #{evalListStdId} ORDER BY emp41_seq
